products.title: 2027 Lunar Almanac — Gothic Moon Phase Calendar (Printable PDF)
products.body_html:
Track the dark half of the sky through 2027. A blackletter almanac framed in restored Renaissance engravings, with every phase of the moon marked by date and time.

What you get

  • 14 pages: cover, year-at-a-glance, and 12 monthly pages with a notes column
  • All 49 moon phases of 2027 with times, plus 2 solar and 3 penumbral lunar eclipses, both equinoxes, both solstices, perihelion, aphelion and daylight saving changes
  • US Letter and A4
  • Two editions: Noir (black pages, for tablets and screens) and Print (white pages, ink-friendly)
  • A CSV of every event with Pacific and UTC times

Times are Pacific Time (PST/PDT). Data comes from the US Naval Observatory; lunar eclipse times come from NASA's eclipse catalog. Eclipse times are greatest eclipse, and visibility depends on where you are.

Instant download. Print at home or at any print shop, or import into GoodNotes or Notability. Personal use. No physical item ships.

products.title: Gothic Engravings & Heraldry Vol. 1 — 32 Public-Domain Elements (PNG + SVG)
products.body_html:
Old-world darkness, cleaned up and ready to work. 32 engravings from 1500s to 1600s masters, including Albrecht Dürer, Wenceslaus Hollar, Stefano della Bella, Heinrich Aldegrever and Sebald Beham, restored into sharp, print-ready linework.

What you get

  • 32 elements as transparent PNG, 3000 px+ on the long side, in black and in white
  • 32 matching SVG vectors, one-click recolor, any size
  • Coats of arms, memento mori skulls, grotesque ornament panels, cartouches, winged beasts, a dragon ewer, an alchemist's lab plate, a crowned initial and long friezes for borders
  • provenance.csv listing every source museum record

Built for shirt graphics, tattoo flash, album and book covers, posters, labels and social posts. Works in Procreate, Photoshop, Illustrator, Affinity, Canva, Kittl, Inkscape and Cricut.

About the source: every original is a public-domain print from The Metropolitan Museum of Art's Open Access collection (CC0). The originals stay free for everyone. You're paying for the work: curating a themed set, cropping, removing paper tone and plate marks, cleaning to crisp black linework, high-res transparent PNGs in two colors, and traced vectors. The Met does not endorse this product.

License: personal and commercial use in finished products (apparel, prints, tattoos, covers, packaging). Do not resell or share the files as a pack or clip-art set.
